title: Field repetition out of range
description:
Layout-quality rule — a layout object displays a field repetition higher than the number of repetitions the field actually has. The object stays empty at runtime; this usually follows a field definition that was reduced later.

Based on the fmCheckMate check "Field repetition out of range" — https://github.com/mrwatson-de/fmCheckMate-XSLT
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A repetition beyond the field definition can never hold data. The object looks functional in Layout mode but is permanently blank for users.
rule.remediation: Point the object at an existing repetition, or raise the field's repetition count if the higher one was intended.
